text: On one wall hangs a picture of a fella who sure knows how to have a laugh, a man after your own heart. You always thought he looked a lot like Michael Cera. But your DAD swears on the many HALLOWED TOMBS of Egypt that it is not. You're not sure about that though.
On the other wall is one of your DAD'S stupid clowns. Or HARLEQUINS, as he is quick to correct anyone who would venture such brazen assumption.
alt: John stands in the hallway, where there are two wall hangings: a picture of Michael Cera wearing a beagle puss disguise, and a picture of a posing harlequin with painfully saturated colors.
